cases.title: Add valid task via Add Task button and check UI updates
cases.description: Verify that entering a valid task description in the 'task-input' field and clicking the 'add-task-btn' successfully adds the task to 'task-list', clears the input field, and reveals the 'clear-all-btn'.

cases.title: Attempt to add empty or whitespace-only task via button
cases.description: Verify that entering empty text or whitespace into 'task-input' and clicking 'add-task-btn' does not add any task to the list and leaves 'clear-all-btn' hidden if the list is empty.

cases.title: Add task by pressing the Enter key
cases.description: Verify that typing a valid task description in 'task-input' and pressing the 'Enter' key adds the trimmed task to 'task-list', clears the input field, and shows the 'clear-all-btn'.

cases.title: Press Enter with empty or whitespace input
cases.description: Verify that pressing the 'Enter' key while 'task-input' is empty or contains only whitespace does not add a task and keeps the input field empty.

cases.title: Toggle task completion status using the complete button
cases.description: Verify that clicking the 'complete-btn' on a task entry visually updates the task by adding or removing the 'completed' class on its DOM element.

cases.title: Delete an individual task and update clear-all visibility
cases.description: Verify that clicking the 'delete-btn' for a task removes it from the DOM, and if it was the last task, hides the 'clear-all-btn'.

cases.title: Clear all tasks using the Clear All button
cases.description: Verify that clicking the 'clear-all-btn' removes all tasks from 'task-list' and hides the button itself afterwards.

cases.title: Verify default placeholder text on task input field
cases.description: Verify that upon full page load, the task input field displays the placeholder text 'Enter a new task...' by default.

opinions.feedback: All proposed test cases are distinct, fully testable, and accurately cover the requirements without any blockers or missing scenarios.

analysis.analysis: e2edev_bench_32-R-2: Testable behavior: Adding a valid task via 'Add Task' button ('add-task-btn') or 'Enter' key into 'task-input', input clearing, list updating with 'task-list', displaying completion time input, completion/delete buttons, and 'clear-all-btn' visibility. Boundaries: Valid non-empty trimmed text vs empty or whitespace-only text. Normal path: Entering valid text and clicking the button or pressing Enter adds the task, clears input, and shows 'clear-all-btn'. Abnormal path: Entering empty or whitespace-only text prevents task addition and keeps 'clear-all-btn' hidden if no tasks exist. Ambiguities: Exact animation specs are unspecified. e2edev_bench_32-R-3: Testable behavior: Adding a task by pressing 'Enter' on 'task-input', triggering 'Add Task', validating input trimming, clearing the input field, updating 'task-list', and toggling 'clear-all-btn'. Boundaries: Whitespace-only/empty string vs valid strings. Normal path: Pressing Enter with valid text adds the task and clears the input. Abnormal path: Pressing Enter with empty/whitespace input adds nothing and keeps input empty. Ambiguities: None. e2edev_bench_32-R-4: Testable behavior: Toggling task completion status using the 'Completed' button ('complete-btn') which adds/removes the 'completed' class on the DOM element for single or multiple tasks simultaneously. Boundaries: Single task toggle vs multiple tasks toggle. Normal path: Clicking 'complete-btn' toggles the 'completed' class. Abnormal path: Clicking on a non-existent button or task (handled implicitly by framework). Ambiguities: Simultaneous toggle mechanism is not fully detailed. e2edev_bench_32-R-5: Testable behavior: Deleting individual tasks using the 'delete-btn' class within 'task-list', removing the task from the DOM, and hiding 'clear-all-btn' if the list becomes empty. Boundaries: Deleting when multiple tasks exist vs deleting the last remaining task. Normal path: Clicking 'delete-btn' removes the task; if list is empty, 'clear-all-btn' is hidden. Abnormal path: Deleting from an empty list (if accessible). Ambiguities: None. e2edev_bench_32-R-6: Testable behavior: Clearing all tasks using 'clear-all-btn' and hiding the button afterward. Boundaries: Clicking when tasks exist vs clicking when list is empty (button should be hidden). Normal path: Clicking 'clear-all-btn' removes all tasks from 'task-list' and hides the button. Abnormal path: Button is hidden and inaccessible when list is empty. Ambiguities: None. e2edev_bench_32-R-7: Testable behavior: Default placeholder text 'Enter a new task...' on 'task-input' upon page load, remaining visible until typing starts. Boundaries: Before typing vs after typing. Normal path: Placeholder is visible on initial load and disappears when input receives text. Abnormal path: None. Ambiguities: None.
